Problem Statement:
Given a string S, remove all vowels (a, e, i, o, u – both lowercase and uppercase) from it and print the resulting string. 
Input Description:
A single line string S. 
Output Description:
Print the string after removing all vowels. 
Sample Input:
beautiful 
Sample Output:
btfl
